top_signals.title: Prosecutors uncover trucking playbook in multimillion-dollar port smuggling scheme
top_signals.summary:
A secret trucking playbook warned drivers about GPS trackers and surveillance. Federal investigators uncovered encrypted messages, counterfeit customs seals and payments tied to a multimillion-dollar smuggling operation at California ports.

The post Prosecutors uncover trucking playbook in multimillion-dollar port smuggling scheme appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI-Linked Stocks Take Off as Nvidia Brings Back ‘Black Jacket’
top_signals.summary: Shares of companies tied to artificial intelligence surged Monday after Nvidia Corp. reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
